temporal_skew.assessment: No catastrophic calendar interval hole was found. The dominant completeness risk was category/query capping rather than a missing quarter.

arxiv_cap_audit.assessment: A successful base collector run is not an exhaustiveness proof. Targeted exact-paper checks were required for material research claims; Mamba (arXiv:2312.00752) was a confirmed material omission from a capped December cs.LG slice and was restored through supplemental collection.

residual_limitations: Twenty-three capped arXiv month/category slices prevent any claim of exhaustive research-paper collection; targeted material-paper checks mitigate editorial gaps but do not make the base corpus exhaustive.

Current publisher index snapshots cannot prove that every 2023 first-party item remains linked today; exact historical first-party pages were collected where the coverage audit identified material gaps.

A planned exact historical llama.cpp commit locator returned 404 during deterministic collection. No replacement source was invented; commit-level local-runtime history therefore remains an explicit limitation.
Runway Gen-2's living first-party research page preserves system identity but does not by itself establish every historical public-availability transition with day-level precision.
Absence from a present-day publisher index, release feed, or capped category slice is not treated as evidence that an event did not occur.

screening_boundary.policy: All normalized records remained auditable; non-promoted records were deterministically materialized as DROP after annual coverage review rather than removed from Raw provenance.

single_volume_assessment.rationale: The audited material forms interacting annual trajectories across frontier interaction, open weights, tool/action interfaces, runtime/adaptation, reasoning/retrieval/architecture, generative media, and evaluation/control. The evidence does not require two independent historical eras or a cadence split.
